Getting to this point required fixing two real bugs: (1) rule 100211 originally referenced a Sysmon rule group name that doesn't exist in Wazuh's ruleset (sysmon_event13 vs the real sysmon_event_13, see Rules/persistence-run-key-cron.xml for the full root-cause), and (2) the dc01-lab Wazuh agent was stuck disconnected because of a stale duplicate agent registration on the manager (same hostname registered twice after a client.keys reset), which had to be removed via manage_agents before the agent could re-enroll and start forwarding Sysmon telemetry again.
